scope: Eight macOS TTS utterances, two repeats, same 16 kHz mono PCM WAV files. Auto language, ITN enabled. Backend latency only; no microphone, refinement, GUI or text insertion. Not a representative accuracy benchmark.
memoryCaveat: Whole process RSS, not model bytes. SenseVoice reports process high-water mark; Whisper reports sampled host RSS, which does not fully describe Metal allocations. Not directly equivalent peak-memory measurements.

whisper.runtime: whisper.cpp large-v3-turbo, Metal, 4 CPU threads; HTTP /inference includes request overhead
